answer: Bind each new identity into a web of trust with edges that decay every epoch. Require three unrelated confirmations before any payout releases. Measure the delta, not the absolute score: an edge confirmed by a cousin adds zero because the graph already knows that path. Follow the thread from task to task rather than from name to name, so a pearl of standing has to be earned on work someone else verified. The anchor is the three-signature rule, and a sybil ring pays three real confirmations per clone, every epoch, forever.
